map_features.note: Editorial point along the 2004 surveyed inner southeast Greenland shelf; not a surveyed jet core or path endpoint. Distinct from the shelfbreak East Greenland Current.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Declared southeast Greenland coastal study-area reach from an OSW offshore gate near 66 N to a Cape Farewell offshore gate near 60 N. Excludes the weak northern 68 N identification, EGC shelfbreak path, Irminger Current, offshore diversions and West Greenland continuation. Not the full EGCC or the source-reported approximately 1000 km surveyed shelf. Near 63 N, the coastal and shelfbreak flows approach or merge; the line does not establish uninterrupted independent coastal flow. The local 30 km Cape Farewell width is not a buffer around this reach.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

scope_notes.summary: The 66 N to Cape Farewell editorial reach is separate from the source approximately 1000 km shelf survey. Weak northern identification and merging near 63 N limit continuity claims. The 30 km Cape Farewell width uses a 15% inner-jet velocity threshold and cannot buffer this whole route or supply annual margins.

widths.boundary_rule: Lateral bounds where velocity decreases to 15% of the maximum inner jet velocity; width scale wobs. The separately defined depth scale uses the 34-isohaline at the bottom.
widths.extraction_method: Author-reported prose width and threshold transcribed; no section figure or velocity field digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: Cape Farewell JR105 section 1 near 60 N; not the entire southeast Greenland shelf.
widths.layer: Gridded absolute geostrophic velocity referenced to shipboard ADCP; no fixed depth averaging layer extracted. The separate 75 m frontal depth scale is not width-layer thickness.
widths.name: East Greenland Coastal Current
widths.range_interpretation: No numeric source width uncertainty or annual range extracted.
remaining_gates: Review boundary definition and regional/layer sampling.

widths.source_locator: Section 2.1: July-August 2004 JR105; Section 2.3: absolute geostrophic velocity reference; Section 3.1, PDF pages 9-10: 15% lateral criterion and Cape Farewell wobs = 30 km.
widths.source_quality_note: Source uses 3-5 km station spacing and 3 km by 10 m gridding. Reported 75 m frontal depth scale is separate; no fine boundary accuracy inferred.
widths.time_convention: July-August 2004 JR105 campaign; exact occupation date of section 1 not extracted. Not a recurring summer phase or climatology.
